caption: Three independent Auto connections; the routing panel stays hidden while nothing is selected.
A rubber-band drag across the canvas puts all three connections into the batch and the routing panel announces how many it applies to.
Picking S-bend once restyles every selected connection as a single undoable command.
One Ctrl+Z restores all three connections to their previous Auto routes.
Clicking one batch member dissolves the batch but keeps exactly that connection selected (review fix).
